text:
maya: Quick sync  Need final microcopy for the landing frame covering Hosted / Dedicated / Private. One hero, three bullets, and mode-specific CTA. Also prep launch-post snippets and webinar invite copy. Who can take which piece? :spiral_notepad:
owen: I can take hero + subhead. Thinking short + outcome: 'Serve LLMs reliably, anywhere you run them.' Subhead: 'Hosted for instant access, Dedicated for committed throughput, Private for regulated deployments.'
rachel_marketing: I'll do the social snippets and webinar subject lines. For posts let's keep two tones: bold benefit and technical hook. Example tweet: 'High-throughput LLM serving. Predictable latency. Pick Hosted, Dedicated, or Private.'
devon_ops: Ops notes: forms for Private must include company_size, compliance_requirements, deploy_preference (VPC/on-prem), and utm_campaign. Prefer calendar CTA for demos. Hidden field lead_tag=enterprise_private.
anya_sdr: Confirmed. Route any lead with utm_campaign=private_launch to the enterprise queue and tag `enterprise_private`. Also add `desired_timeframe` for triage.
maya: For proof points midpage: short lines 1) 'P95 latency < 120ms on typical configs' 2) 'Up to 3x token cost reduction with batching & cache' 3) 'Deploy where you need  hosted, reserved, or in your VPC.' Keep claims linked to benchmarks.
owen: Hero variants: A) 'Deploy fast. Serve reliably.' B) 'Predictable LLM serving across hosted, reserved, and private.' C) 'Low-latency, cost-aware LLM serving for production.' React with emoji for preference.
rachel_marketing: For the webinar CTA: 'Join our 30-min demo + benchmark walk-through.' Subject tests: 'How we cut token cost 3x' vs 'Predictable low-latency LLM serving  demo'. I'll draft emails.
maya: Great. Next: @owen finalize hero by Wed, @rachel_marketing deliver launch posts and email by Thu, @devon_ops create form field spec. I'll assemble variants Friday AM and push to repo. publish-bot: Reminder: 'Landing copy review' calendar invite Fri 9am PT created.
anya_sdr: One more ask  include `discovery_channel` and `utm_source` in forms for attribution.
maya: Thanks everyone. Lock if no objections by Thur EOD. :checkered_flag:
